The club competed in the [[2025–26 Premier League|Premier League]], [[2025–26 FA Cup|FA Cup]] and [[2025–26 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]], but not in [[UEFA club competitions|European competitions]] for the first time since [[2014–15 Manchester United F.C. season|2014–15]]. With the retirement of [[Jonny Evans]], United are without a Premier League winner in their squad for the first time since the competition's inaugural season in the [[1992–93 FA Premier League|1992–93 season]], and without a player who had played under Sir [[Alex Ferguson]] for the first time since 1974.{{efn|[[Arthur Albiston]] played for United from 1974 to 1988, in which he spent the last two years under Ferguson.}} [[Ruben Amorim]] began the campaign as head coach but was dismissed in January, after fewer than 14 months in charge due to a disagreement with club's hierarchy.{{Cite news |title=Ruben Amorim departs role as head coach of Man Utd |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/detail/ruben-amorim-departs-role-as-head-coach-of-man-utd|website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=5 January 2026 |access-date=5 January 2026}} Former United midfielder and under-18s manager [[Darren Fletcher]] assumed charge on a caretaker basis. Another former United midfielder, [[Michael Carrick]], was then appointed head coach for the remainder of the season.{{Cite news |title=Official statement: Manchester United appoint Michael Carrick as head coach |url= https://www.manutd.com/en/news/detail/official-statement-manchester-united-appoint-michael-carrick-as-head-coach |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=13 January 2026 |access-date=13 January 2026}} He became the first United manager, permanent or caretaker, to return to the club since [[Matt Busby]] in [[1970–71 Manchester United F.C. season|1970]], having managed the club in three matches in [[2021–22 Manchester United F.C. season|2021]]. As United were eliminated in their first match of both cup competitions for the first time since [[1981–82 Manchester United F.C. season|1981–82]], they played just 40 competitive matches in the season, the fewest since [[1914–15 Manchester United F.C. season|1914–15]], when they played 39.{{Cite web |title='Fragile' Man Utd set for fewest games in season since 1914-15 |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cly53k69xj1o |access-date=11 January 2026 |date=11 January 2026 |website=BBC Sport|author-link=Simon Stone|last=Stone|first=Simon}} This was the club's first consecutive trophyless campaign since [[2021–22 Manchester United F.C. season|2021–22]]. Despite the cup competition disappointments, the season in regards to league form was a vast improvement compared to the previous season with United finishing the season in third place, twelve places higher than they managed during the previous season, securing a return to the [[UEFA Champions League]] for the [[2026–27 Manchester United F.C. season|2026–27]] - which will be their first participation in Europe's elite club competition since [[2023–24 Manchester United F.C. season|2023–24]]. Captain [[Bruno Fernandes]] also broke the Premier League 21 assists record and received the [[FWA Footballer of the Year|FWA Player of the Year]] and [[Premier League Player of the Season]]. ==Pre-season and friendlies== On 9 March 2025, Manchester United confirmed their participation in the Premier League Summer Series in the [[United States]], where they would face [[West Ham United F.C.|West Ham United]], [[AFC Bournemouth|Bournemouth]] and [[Everton F.C.|Everton]].{{Cite web |last=Department |first=Communications |title=United join Premier League Summer Series {{!}} Manchester United |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/man-utd-tour-2025-of-united-states-fixture-details |access-date=2026-05-27 |website=www.manutd.com |language=en}} On 19 March 2025, the club announced a pre-season friendly against [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]] in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]], marking the club's return to the [[Nationalarenan|Strawberry Arena]] where they lifted the [[UEFA Europa League]] trophy in [[2017 UEFA Europa League final|2017]].{{Cite web |title=Leeds United to play Manchester United in Stockholm - Leeds United |url=https://www.leedsunited.com/en/news/leeds-united-to-play-manchester-united-in-stockholm |access-date=2026-05-27 |website=www.leedsunited.com |language=en}} On 30 April 2025, a home friendly against [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] was announced to conclude the club's pre-season schedule, with the match set to mark [[David de Gea|David De Gea]]'s first appearance at Old Trafford since departing the club in 2023. {{Cite web |last=Department |first=Communications |title=United announce Snapdragon Cup game at Old Trafford {{!}} Manchester United |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/man-utd-to-play-pre-season-snapdragon-cup-game-v-fiorentina-at-old-trafford |access-date=2026-05-27 |website=www.manutd.com |language=en}} {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !Date !Opponents !H / A !Result
